title: "Troubleshooting"

::: {.callout-note title="Teaching outline"}
This chapter introduces the workflow. Apply it with the reviewed variable map and study protocol; the analysis templates are components, not a validated turnkey pipeline.
:::


# Common programming problems

## File will not load

Check:

- path
- delimiter
- encoding
- expected number of columns
- supplied import/layout script

## Regression fails

Check:

- missing values
- outcome coding
- perfect separation
- duplicate predictors
- sparse categories

## Unexpected sample-size loss

Print the cohort size after every filtering step.
